title: 500 ms window, 76 % overlap · total torque
description: Total-torque version (nothing subtracted): 500 ms window (10 steps of 50 ms) with 76 % overlap between consecutive training windows: a new training window every 120 ms (1/12 of the windows of the "Length 500 ms" setting, which starts a window every 10 ms). Validation and test keep every window. Caveat: fewer windows also means proportionally fewer weight updates per epoch under the same epoch limit, so this changes the amount of training as well as the overlap. Everything else as the reference: Active torque (each session's own relaxed-hold passive torque subtracted), EMG ÷ session-1 maximum, no per-angle loss scaling (plain mean-squared error, every angle weighted by its own torque), LSTM 16 units × 2 layers, dropout 0.0, learning rate 0.01 (chosen by a validation-loss search), trained with batch 64 for at most 150 epochs (fast protocol: learning rate × 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15, at most 150 epochs), trained on session 1 and tested on session 2, 6 people × 10 seeds. The EMG envelope is causal (forward-only filters: no input uses later EMG, as in a real-time device; 2nd-order 2 Hz low-pass, about 125 ms lag) and the first and last 1 s of every trial are cut. Validation windows start one window span after the training part of each trial, so no validation window reuses training inputs (purged split). Training windows are fed in time order (no shuffling).
